version.description: Hashing scheme version for the ledger. If omitted, defaults to HASHING_SCHEME_VERSION_V3

publicUrl.description: The public base URL of the gateway, if available (e.g. https://wallet.example.com). This determines what browsers will try to use to connect, and is useful when using reverse proxies. If omitted, this will be derived from the server configuration.

logging.description: Optional logging configuration. If omitted, defaults will be used.

format.description: The log format for the gateway. If omitted, defaults to pretty.

level.description: The log level for the gateway. If omitted, defaults to info.

admin.description: The JWT claim (e.g. "sub") identifying the admin user. If set, requests with a matching claim will be granted admin privileges.

allowedOrigins.description: Allowed CORS origins, typically corresponding to which external dApps are allowed to connect. Use "*" to allow all origins, or set an array of origin strings.

dappPath.description: The path serving the dapp API. Defaults /api/v0/dapp

host.description: The host interface the server binds to. Deprecated as the service always binds to the local machine network interface. Will be removed in a future release.

port.description: The port on which the NodeJS service will listen. Defaults to 3030.

requestRateLimit.description: The maximum number of requests per minute from a single IP address. Defaults to 10000.

requestSizeLimit.description: The maximum size of incoming requests. Defaults to 1mb.

pollInterval.description: Interval in milliseconds for the signing worker to poll external signing providers on pending transactions. Defaults to 5000.

tls.description: Deprecated, this option no longer has any effect. Will be removed in a future release.

trustProxy.description: Express trust proxy setting used to resolve client IP addresses when running behind reverse proxies/load balancers. Set this correctly in production (for example 1 for a single trusted proxy hop). Defaults to false.

userPath.description: The path serving the user API. Defaults /api/v0/user

signingProviders.description: Explicit signing provider configuration. When omitted, the Wallet Gateway uses legacy discovery: every provider is available if its required environment variables are set. When present, only listed providers are registered; non-secret settings come from this object, and secrets are read from environment variables named by the *Env fields.

bitgo.description: Include this object to opt in BitGo. The access token is read from the environment variable named by accessTokenEnv.

accessTokenEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the BitGo access token. The secret value stays in the environment and is never stored in the config file.

coin.description: BitGo Canton coin identifier. Auto-detected from the API URL when omitted.

enterpriseId.description: BitGo enterprise ID. Required for wallet creation.

blockdaemon.description: Include this object to opt in Blockdaemon. The API key is read from the environment variable named by apiKeyEnv.

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the Blockdaemon API key. The secret value stays in the environment and is never stored in the config file.

dfns.description: Include this object to opt in Dfns. Requires orgId and credId. Secrets are read from the environment variables named by privateKeyEnv and authTokenEnv.

authTokenEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the Dfns service account auth token. The secret value stays in the environment and is never stored in the config file.

privateKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the Dfns service account private key. The secret value stays in the environment and is never stored in the config file.

fireblocks.description: Include this object to opt in Fireblocks. Secrets are read from the environment variables named by apiKeyEnv and secretEnv.

apiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the Fireblocks API key. The secret value stays in the environment and is never stored in the config file.

secretEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the Fireblocks API secret. The secret value stays in the environment and is never stored in the config file.

participant.description: Include this object to opt in the participant signing provider.

securosys.description: Include this object to opt in Securosys. Requires baseUrl. Secrets are read from the environment variables named by the *Env fields.

bearerTokenEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the Securosys bearer token. The secret value stays in the environment and is never stored in the config file.

keyManagementApiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the Securosys key-management API key. The secret value stays in the environment and is never stored in the config file.

keyOperationApiKeyEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the Securosys key-operation API key. The secret value stays in the environment and is never stored in the config file.

keyPasswordEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the Securosys key password. The secret value stays in the environment and is never stored in the config file.

mtlsP12PasswordEnv.description: Name of the environment variable that holds the Securosys PKCS#12 password. The secret value stays in the environment and is never stored in the config file.

mtlsP12Path.description: Path to a PKCS#12 client certificate when TSB requires mTLS.

walletKernel.description: Include this object to opt in the Wallet Kernel internal signing provider. Requires signingStore.
